definition{

definition{

definition{

definition{

definition{

definition{

definition{

definition{

definition{

definition{

definition{
  name: sameDigest,
  parameters: [left : Digest, right : Digest],
  result: Bool,
  body: (((project left w0) =? (project right w0)) && (((project left w1) =? (project right w1)) && (((project left w2) =? (project right w2)) && ((project left w3) =? (project right w3)))))
}

definition{

}

definition{
  name: accepts,

}

definition{
  name: Accepts,
  parameters: [check : Check],
  result: Prop,
  body: ((SameDigest (project check expected) (project check observed)) /\ ((project check expectedSize) = (project check observedSize)))

definition{
  name: byteNat,
  parameters: [value : Bytes, offset : Nat],

  body: (match (Foundation.Bytes::byteAt value offset)
    | Option.none => 255
    | Option.some byte => (prim to_nat byte : Nat)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: remaining
}

definition{
